entitymodel.title: Asset ERP Plugin: Entity Model v6
entitymodel.description: 51 entities: full lifecycle from acquisition through disposal. Naming: Asseterp prefix on entity names, asseterpXxxId on PKs, OFBiz standard names on all FK fields to OFBiz tables, no prefix on regular descriptive fields. All statusId fields relate to StatusItem (OFBiz standard). All *TypeId lookup fields relate to Enumeration (OFBiz standard) via one-nofk. AsseterpEventType removed — event types use EnumerationType/Enumeration. AsseterpLifecycleEvent.enumId replaces asseterpEventTypeId. Indexes declared for all reporting and UI query patterns.
